lyrics:
Verse 1:
Hey there, have you heard the news about your Mac?
It's got a brand new feature called Localized AI in Action!
Now your device can understand what you write or type
And offer suggestions that just might be right!

Chorus:
Localized AI on your Mac, making things so neat
Personalization is now supreme! (Ah ah)
With local knowledge at its core, data stays secure and tight
Say goodbye to privacy worries, now that's a feature we delight!

Verse 2:
Imagine you're working late in your cozy home space
Your Mac knows the context of every word you create  
Whether it's a note or an email, it learns what fits best
And suggests improvements right when you need them pressed!

(Repeat Chorus)

Bridge:
When you're brainstorming ideas on a comfy couch at night
Your Mac will understand and help you find your light
From planning meals to organizing photos in a snap
Localized AI makes every task feel like a game of fun, not a drag!

(Repeat Chorus)

Outro:
Localized AI on your Mac, simplifying life's tasks
Personalization is now second best! (Ah ah)
With local knowledge guiding the way, data stays out of sight  
Embrace this future of computing, and productivity will thrive with might!
